about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Eldrazi Incursion (Ulalek, Fused Atrocity: whenever you cast an Eldrazi spell, you may pay {C}{C} to copy every spell and every other ability you control). Stock Forge never pays Ulalek's trigger (0 copies in 12 audit games, 63 triggers put on the stack) and casts Ulalek on its own turn 6.5 on average. Rules: Sol Ring, then Ulalek at once, then the other rocks (a rock cast first had cost Ulalek a turn); Sire of Stagnation only while Ulalek is not on the battlefield (held otherwise), because copies of Sire draw two per Sire per opponent land and milled the seat in a tuning game (seven copies); the cost reducers and engines (Herald's Horn, Forsaken Monument, Ugin, Awakening Zone, Garruk's Uprising, Mystic Forge, Dreamstone Hedron), then the creatures dearest first; Ulamog's Dreadsire's 10/10 after combat (vigilance); the draw spells while 30 cards remain; Idol of Oblivion's 10/10 and its draw. Eldrazi Monument is held until five creatures, two of them tokens: its upkeep sacrifice ate Ulalek and the board in a tuning game. Trigger: Ulalek's copy paid while Forge estimates 10 mana or less left, declined above. Each copy of the trigger copies every spell on the stack again, so accepting without the cap doubled one creature spell into a thousand copies and two of twelve games ran into the clock as draws and one into the turn cap; the mana bound caps a chain at about five payments. Go-wide attack from two attackers up. Goldfish: audit seeds 15002-15013 stock 11.33, this file 10.25; tuning seeds 15022-15041 stock 11.65, this file 10.45 (+1.20, 95% +0.76 to +1.64).
